analyses.long_business_summary: ASKUL Corporation engages in e-commerce business in Japan. The company operates ASKUL, a website for small and medium-sized enterprises, as well as SOLOEL ARENA, a website for mid-tier and larger companies that provides office supplies, living supplies, furniture, general medical, pharmaceuticals, and medical equipment products. analyses.name: 神戸物産
analyses.long_business_summary: Kobe Bussan Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the manufacture, wholesale, and retail food products, and franchise supermarket chain in Japan. The company offers a range of food products through its Gyomu superstores. It also operates a chain of buffet restaurants under the Kobe Cook World Buffet brand; a chain of served a-la-carte buffet style BBQ restaurants under the Premium Karubi brand; and a chain of delicatessen shops under the concept of offering everyday dining under the CHISOUNA brand.
